Legacy flat scope input remains compatibility-only and is not an authority source.

ID-010.decision: The ID-010 source implementation and generated identity contract are integrated on this base. Its only recorded remainder is prohibited Cargo validation, so no source dependency work is unresolved for CORE-001.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: MissionCanvasAuthorityContext::new/from_parts validates the WorkstreamKey and exact AttachmentKey owner; a foreign AttachmentKey returns foreign_attachment_workstream.
negative_cases.missing_authority: WorkstreamKey is required by the generated schema and ScopeQuery parses it explicitly; no scope constructor accepts project_root or continuity_id as authority.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: Existing Mission Canvas projection/store revision and event-cursor gates remain unchanged and are covered by the existing projection/state contract checks; this identity slice does not weaken them.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: Existing generated projection omission diagnostics and fail-closed capability/permission checks remain unchanged; generated parity and projection-contract checks pass.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Existing deterministic omission/recomposition behavior remains unchanged; projection, resolved-projection, and Work Rail checks pass.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: LegacyExactScopeCompatibilityInput remains a separately named generated compatibility schema. It has no WorkstreamKey and cannot validate as WorkstreamAuthorityContext; no local resolver or identity inference was added.

acceptance.statement: MissionCanvasScope no longer uses project_root plus continuity_id as authority.
acceptance.proof: The canonical model contains WorkstreamKey authority, constructor-based validation, and no project_root/session/attachment flat fields; the CORE-001 source contract and ID-010 identity contract pass.

acceptance.statement: project_root plus continuity_id cannot bind or focus a Work Surface.
acceptance.proof: Scope construction requires generated WorkstreamKey input, exact Attachment ownership is checked, and legacy-only input is compatibility-schema-only. No CWD, tab, latest-record, or nearest-candidate resolver exists in the changed slice.

acceptance.statement: ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined, not guessed.
acceptance.proof: The explicit LegacyExactScopeCompatibilityInput boundary remains intact and the existing Spec 158 migration/quarantine authority is unchanged; no legacy mapping or inference was introduced by CORE-001.
